text: Code reviews are an essential part of modern software development. When developers review each other's code before it is merged, they can catch bugs early, when problems are still cheap and easy to fix. This saves the team time and prevents small mistakes from becoming serious issues later. Code reviews also encourage knowledge sharing, because reviewers learn how their colleagues solve problems and understand different parts of the project. Finally, regular reviews raise the overall quality of the team's work, since everyone feels responsible for the code and follows shared standards. In short, code reviews make software safer and teams stronger.
